undo.description: Steps that reverse the change, run after a test

verified.description: true only if test_manifest passed for exactly these steps, verification and undo

type.description: hotkey: run steps on a key. app_opened: run steps when the app opens. file_saved: run steps each time the file at path is saved. toolbar: show buttons beside the app, each with its own steps. watch: run steps when the app window's pixels change, or settle after changing. title: run steps when the app's active window title matches a pattern for some seconds

accelerator.description: hotkey: the key, e.g. 'Ctrl+Alt+D'. toolbar: optional key that focuses the toolbar for keyboard use. Pick keys the app doesn't use

path.description: file_saved: the file to watch, usually {document.path}

mode.description: changed: fire when the window changes. settled: fire when it stops changing, for 'tell me when it finishes'

pattern.description: Case-insensitive regular expression for the window title, e.g. '/ X — Zen Browser$'

seconds.description: How long the title must match while the window is active, 1 to 86400. Fires once per visit

reads.description: What the sub-app reads, in plain words

exhausted.description: Required only when a script step exists: one entry per route rank 1 to 5. Otherwise empty

buttons.description: toolbar only, 1 to 6 buttons. Empty for other triggers

label.description: Short button text, e.g. 'Shrink to 800 px'
